author: Eric Hanfman
releaseNotes: Runtime checkpoints: while equipment keeps running, the app reports the runtime so far every 15 minutes instead of one total when it stops, so long runs (e.g. a fan left on for days, which Core rejected as one total over 24 hours) are counted on every day they cover and show while running. Runtime is only counted while the hub confirms the thermostat; after a reboot or an hour without confirmation the run is closed at the last confirmation. Fixes: 'pending heat/cool' no longer counts as running; quick mode switches credit each mode its own time; a run's end is never dropped by duplicate suppression; events are kept for retry when a Core token can't be issued or the hub restarts mid-send. Nothing to do after updating: checkpoints start on their own within 5 minutes.
